key.name: enabled
key.description: When off, Ari's model and tools stop and nothing is asked of her. Administrators can lock this key with dconf to keep assistants off a managed machine.

key.name: approval-mode
key.summary: When Ari asks before making a change
key.description: "all": ask every time. "system": ask for important actions, once per requested application task. "never": skip Ari's confirmations. Advanced action permissions override these defaults. Application, operating-system and administrator controls still apply.
